title: The letter
steps: This is the castle of Arvelia, the school for young wizards, boys and girls. It is old and stands high on a hill above a deep lake.
Some weeks ago a letter came to you: the invitation to your first year at Arvelia, signed by the head of the school, Orla. This very drawing came with it, and your heart leaped.
Then came the journey: packing your bags, the long road, the village at the foot of the hill, and the steep climb at dusk that brought you here.
Now you stand before the great iron gate. It is shut tight, with no handle and no bell, and you have no idea how to get in. But it is very quiet, almost as if it were listening.
Before the story goes on, just one question: who are you?
